_deliberately_excluded.fontFamily: Same reason — Nationale/TabacG1 are licensed Marvin identity. FourlinQ uses Manrope/Fraunces by decision, not by accident.
_deliberately_excluded.note: This gate measures STRUCTURE ONLY. A rising score must never come from adopting Marvin's brand.

elevation._note: Premium feel comes from LOW elevation. Marvin's deepest common shadow blurs only 9px.
